newsitem.title: POLAND: CARDBOARD FIRM TO INVEST $300 MLN IN POLAND.
newsitem.headline: CARDBOARD FIRM TO INVEST $300 MLN IN POLAND.

text.p: Big Carton Sp. zoo, which in January opened a corrugated cardboard plant in Poland, plans to invest $300 million within three years in paper and packaging production in the country, its president said.
"Within three years we plan to invest $300 million in carborad, paper and packaging production in Poland," Arthur Burdasch told a news conference on Saturday.
Burdasch said that within three years Big Carton should produce about 20 million square meters of packaging materials per month, meeting two-thirds of Poland's packaging needs.
Swiss firm Overseas Enterprises Co Ltd has a 57.6 percent stake in Big Carton, Arthur Burdasch of Germany has a 27.8 percent stake and Roman Kurek of Poland has 14.6 percent.
Burdasch said Big Carton, which planned to employ some 1,000 people within three years, eventually wanted to enter the Warsaw bourse.
"We already started to change our firm into a joint stock company and, in the longer perspecitve, we want to enter the Warsaw Stock Exchange," he said.

Big Carton opened a $20 million cardboard plant near the north-western Polish city of Szczecin and plans to build another corrugated cardbord factory over the next three years near Warsaw at about the same cost and a paper factory.
